[[File:Wintersday The Wondrous Workshop of Toymaker Tixx banner.jpg|500px|right]] [[Wintersday]] is an annual [[festival]] which celebrates the [[Tyria]]n New Year according to the [[Mouvelian calendar]] and [[gww:Dynastic Reckoning|Dynastic Reckoning]]. It is the celebration of the end of the Season of the Colossus and the beginning of the Season of the Zephyr. Since the destruction of [[Lion's Arch]], the event is held in [[Divinity's Reach]], with [[Portal to Wintersday|portals]] set around all major cities for easier access. == Releases == * [[Wintersday: The Wondrous Workshop of Toymaker Tixx]] (2012-12-14 — 2013-01-03) * [[Wintersday 2013|A Very Merry Wintersday 2013]] (2013-12-10 — 2014-01-21) * [[Wintersday 2014|A Very Merry Wintersday 2014]] (2014-12-16 — 2015-01-13) * [[Wintersday 2015|A Very Merry Wintersday 2015]] (2015-12-15 — 2016-01-12) * [[Wintersday 2016|A Very Merry Wintersday 2016]] (2016-12-13 — 2017-01-10) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2017]] (2017-12-12 — 2018-01-02) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2018]] (2018-12-11 — 2019-01-02) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2019]] (2019-12-17 — 2020-01-07) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2020]] (2020-12-15 — 2021-01-05) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2021]] (2021-12-14 — 2022-01-04) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2022]] (2022-12-13 — 2023-01-03) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2023]] (2023-12-12 — 2024-01-02) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2024]] (2024-12-10 — 2025-01-02) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2025]] (2025-12-09 — 2026-01-06) * [[A Very Merry Wintersday 2026]] (2026-12-08 — 2027-01-05) == Activities == {| {{STDT|promo}} style="max-width:134em;" |- ! style="width:15em;" class="line-right | Activity ! class="line-right | Added ! style="width:43em;" class="line-right| Description !
